parent_objective: audit residual-support classification and choose next non-ranking route
blocked_by: M2321 classifies 48 residual scenarios across R2-R5
R4 mitigation semantics/support redesign must be separated from ordinary avoidance failure
supersedes: support-policy ranking from residual support counts
manual residual inspection without route decision

public_gates: M2322 must audit M2321 completeness and guardrails
M2322 must accept or reject residual route-label classification
M2322 must choose a non-ranking follow-up route
M2322 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim residual support solved

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits route-label classification over 48 residual scenarios and chooses next branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2321 artifacts are incomplete
stop if audit routes directly to training or ranking
stop if residual support is claimed solved
stop if R4 mitigation route is ignored
fallback_plan: route to R4 mitigation semantics/support design if mitigation residual dominates
route to coverage-vs-redesign audit if support coverage residual dominates
route to branch synthesis if route labels are contradictory

allowed_updates: M2322 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2321 completeness and guardrails are audited
route-label classification is accepted or rejected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2322 audits support artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2322; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Residual-support findings must not be interpreted as driver weakness before route-specific design.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns residual support classification into a route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether to prioritize R4 mitigation semantics or broader support coverage/redesign
must_synthesize_if: the residual-support branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: M2321 provides enough residual-support classification evidence to choose a non-ranking follow-up route.
success_criteria: a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2322 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2322 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2322 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2322 cannot select a next route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual artifact audit of runs/m2321_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_residual_support_audit/summary.json and route summaries

decision_rule: M2322 passes if it audits M2321 and selects a non-ranking follow-up route.
